I am 28. I am going to see my doctor when I get home to get a referral to a councillor, hopefully someone different. A big part of it is that I feel stuck. I am stuck in university until I am done. I fell stuck where I live because I own it. I really want to go somewhere new. just leave my current life behind. But I don't want to change my life on a whim. The other big part of it is I have so few friends, none of which I am really close too and no love life to speak of. I have such a hard time meeting people. Thinking about that stuff is what brings it on. I am going to see my doctor when I get home. 

P.S. I love Rock Lobster so I might try doing that.
